verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs show a query system ({{query}}) for asking questions of the knowledge base and page/block reference syntax ([[]], (())) that can be used for tag/page filtering, and the app is implied to be local-first (journals, local HTTP server, offline-friendly design). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a full-text search feature, property/path filtering, or search performance, and community reports note indexing and responsiveness 'slow down massively once you have a few million words stored,' undercutting the 'instantly search' claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-text search UI/command, property and path filter syntax, offline search confirmation, and independent verification that search stays fast at scale.
